title: Surveying a triangular plot
stem: Three survey markers A, B and C stand on horizontal ground. AB = 85 m, AC = 62 m and angle BAC = 48°. A vertical mast of height h m stands at C.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the area of triangle ABC.

parts.label: c
parts.notes: Use the unrounded value of BC from part (a); B is acute because AC < BC.

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: The angle of elevation of the top of the mast from A is 15°. Find h.

title: A line meeting a plane
stem: The line L has vector equation r = (1, 2, 0) + λ(2, −1, 1). The plane Π has equation x + y + z = 9.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the coordinates of the point where L meets Π.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the acute angle between L and Π.
parts.notes: 61.9° (the angle between the line and the normal) earns M1 A1 A0.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Find the shortest distance from the point (1, 2, 0) to Π.
markscheme: |1 + 2 + 0 − 9| / √3 / using the perpendicular line r = (1, 2, 0) + t(1, 1, 1) with t = 2
